about_short_description.short_description: Gecko Security finds and fixes security vulnerabilities in codebase, just like having a security engineer making one's code secure.

product.name: AI-Powered Offensive Security
product.description: A tool that detects business logic flaws, broken authentication, and complex multi-step vulnerabilities in codebases using AI techniques.

product.name: Automatic Fixes
product.description: A feature that automatically generates patches to fix identified security vulnerabilities in the codebase.

product.name: Threat Modelling
product.description: A process that creates targeted attack scenarios to test the application code like an attacker would.

product.name: Vulnerability Management
product.description: A system that prioritizes detected vulnerabilities based on their exploitability and impact to guide remediation efforts.

product.name: Codebase Context Mapping
product.description: A feature that maps the entire codebase with context about services, middleware, and authentication components.
